prompt: Ivy finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy
irony: Ivy schemes to keep the lost puppy she found, but a found puppy with a home is only truly found when it is given back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunshine fills the park while Ivy spots a tiny lost puppy near the swings.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Ivy hugs the trembling puppy and claims it as her secret new buddy.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox spots the puppy tag and dares Ivy to hide the puppy from grown-ups.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids gather round the trembling puppy and sing about the lost puppy.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Ivy hides the puppy under the slide, but the puppy bolts after pigeons.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The muddy puppy shakes mud over Knox while Benny lures it with a snack.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The tired puppy yawns in the circle as the kids sing the hook again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Nora kneels by the shaking puppy and sees it needs comfort, not fixing.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Nora decides to find the owner with Ivy, starting door to door at the park.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Nora sings the turned line as Ivy learns keeping means giving back.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Ivy returns the puppy to its porch as the sun sets behind the swings.
